
		<h1 class="postTitle">
			<a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/lemonzhang/p/19592426" title="发布于 2026-02-08 19:27">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Concept Bottleneck Models-概念瓶颈模型用于可解释决策：进展、分类体系 与未来方向综述</span>
    

</a>

		</h1>
		<div class="clear"></div>
		<div class="postBody">
			    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        深度神经网络虽然表现出优异的性能，但其不透明性限制了其在需要透明度和人工监管的高风险领域中的应用。概念瓶颈模型(Concept Bottleneck Models, CBMs)通过引入一个人类可理解的概念层来连接输入与决策，从而解决了这一差距，实现了语义解释和测试时干预。本综述从四个维度提供了一个统一的CBMs概览：概念获取、基于概念的决策制定、概念干预和概念评估。我们总结了概念构建的演变过程，从人工标注到基于词典的挖掘、大语言模型(LLM)/视觉语言模型(VLM）引导的生成，以及通过原型和扩散模型实现的视觉关联发现；回顾了超越严格瓶颈的新兴CBM架构；并整合了强调忠实度、稀疏性和可干预性的评估与干预协议，这些对医疗保健等高风险领域尤为重要。我们综合了零散的文献，并勾勒了基于概念的可解释决策面临的关键挑战和未来方向。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">深度神经网络虽然表现出优异的性能，但其不透明性限制了其在需要透明度和人工监管的高风险领域中的应用。概念瓶颈模型(Concept Bottleneck Models, CBMs)通过引入一个人类可理解的概念层来连接输入与决策，从而解决了这一差距，实现了语义解释和测试时干预。本综述从四个维度提供了一个统一的CBMs概览：概念获取、基于概念的决策制定、概念干预和概念评估。我们总结了概念构建的演变过程，从人工标注到基于词典的挖掘、大语言模型(LLM)/视觉语言模型(VLM）引导的生成，以及通过原型和扩散模型实现的视觉关联发现；回顾了超越严格瓶颈的新兴CBM架构；并整合了强调忠实度、稀疏性和可干预性的评估与干预协议，这些对医疗保健等高风险领域尤为重要。我们综合了零散的文献，并勾勒了基于概念的可解释决策面临的关键挑战和未来方向。</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">

</div>

<h1><span style="font-size: 15pt; font-family: 黑体" lang="EN-US">1 </span><span style="font-size: 15pt; font-family: 黑体">引言</span></h1>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">深度神经网络在视觉、语言和多模态学习方面取得了强大的性能，使其在医疗保健</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[1]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">、医学</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[2]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">和金融</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[3]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">等现实世界中得到广泛采用。然而，它们的决策过程往往是不透明的，这在需要信任、问责制和人类监督的高风险环境中造成了风险</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[4]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">。这种性能与可解释性之间的差距推动了可解释</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">AI (XAI)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">的发展，旨在使模型的推理过程对人类而言是可理解、可验证和可修正的。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">概念瓶颈模型</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(CBMs)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">已成为解决这一挑战的一个原则性且有影响力的范式</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[5]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">。</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBMs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">不是直接将输入映射到输出，而是通过在输入和决策之间引入一个人类可理解的中间概念层，显式地对预测过程进行因式分解。这种结构化的分解实现了语义解释，便于专家检查中间推理过程，并通过概念修正支持测试时干预。这些特性将</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBMs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">与事后解释技术</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[6]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">区分开来，并将其定位为可解释和可控决策的统一框架。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">早期的概念瓶颈模型依赖于手动定义和标注的概念（例如视觉属性或临床发现）来提供透明的中间接口，但受到标注成本、覆盖范围不全和标签噪声的限制</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[5]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">。最近的进展可以组织为基于概念推理的四个阶段：概念获取正从人工策展转向可扩展的词典挖掘、</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">LLM/VLM</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">引导的生成，以及通过原型或扩散模型实现的视觉接地发现，这些都得益于大规模基础模型</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[7, 8, 9]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">；基于概念的决策正从严格的瓶颈向软性、混合、概率和基于能量的设计演变，这些设计在保留概念接口的同时提高了预测能力</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[10, 11, 12, 13]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">；概念干预越来越多地支持结构化和感知依赖关系的修正，以便通过概念层更好地传播人类反馈</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[14, 15]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">；概念评估正从准确性扩展到以可解释性为中心的指标（例如忠实度、干预下的一致性、对噪声或缺失概念的鲁棒性），但在视觉接地、语义稳定性和与人类推理对齐方面仍面临挑战</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[8]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">尽管进展迅速，但</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBM</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">文献仍然是碎片化的。现有的综述</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[16]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">和评论通常侧重于属性学习、基于原型的解释或一般的可解释性方法，但它们并未捕捉到</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBMs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">作为涵盖概念获取、决策架构、干预机制和评估协议的综合框架的更广泛演变。特别是，</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBMs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">与基础模型、可编辑学习和多模态交互的近期融合尚未得到系统性的综合。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">本综述的主要贡献总结如下：</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US"> (1) </span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">提出了涵盖概念获取、决策、干预和评估的</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBMs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">统一分类法。</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US"> (2) </span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">系统回顾了概念构建方法，从人工标注到</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">LLM</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">引导和基于原型的发现。</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US"> (3) </span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">综合了具有不同瓶颈设计和可编辑程度的新兴</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBM</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">架构。</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US"> (4) </span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">整合了评估协议和基准，重点关注忠实度、稀疏性、可干预性和医学应用。</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">我们在</span><span lang="EN-US"><a href="https://github.com/kkzhang95/Awesome_Concept_Bottleneck_Models" rel="noopener nofollow"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体">Awesome Concept Bottleneck Models</span></a></span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">维护了一个包含代表性</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBM</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">论文、代码和基准的更新仓库，以支持复现和社区使用。</span></p>
<h1><span style="font-size: 15pt; font-family: 黑体" lang="EN-US">2 </span><span style="font-size: 15pt; font-family: 黑体">预备知识</span></h1>
<h2><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 黑体" lang="EN-US">2.1 </span><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 黑体">概念瓶颈模型</span></h2>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">概念瓶颈模型</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(CBMs)<sup>[5]</sup></span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">是一类可解释的神经架构，通过称为概念的人类可理解的中间变量，显式地将预测分解为两个阶段。形式上，</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBM</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">将从输入$x \in \mathcal{X}$</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">到目标$y \in \mathcal{Y}$</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">的映射因式分解为：</span><span style="font-size: 10.5pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 11.0pt; font-family: &quot;Calibri&quot;, &quot;sans-serif&quot;; mso-ascii-theme-font: minor-latin; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体; mso-fareast-theme-font: minor-fareast; mso-hansi-theme-font: minor-latin; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-theme-font: minor-bidi; position: relative; top: 3pt; mso-text-raise: -3.0pt; mso-ansi-language: EN-US; mso-fareast-language: ZH-CN; mso-bidi-language: AR-SA" lang="EN-US"></span></p>
<p>\begin{equation}<br>	x \;\rightarrow\; c \;\rightarrow\; y,<br>\end{equation}&nbsp;<span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">其中$c = (c_1, \ldots, c_K) \in \mathcal{C}^K$</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">表示一组可解释的概念，如视觉属性、解剖结构、病理发现或语义描述。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">一个典型的</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBM</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">由两个组件组成：概念预测器$f_{\theta}: \mathcal{X} \rightarrow \mathcal{C}^K$</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">，它将原始输入映射到概念激活；以及任务预测器$g_{\phi}: \mathcal{C}^K \rightarrow \mathcal{Y}$</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">，它仅基于预测的概念产生最终预测。整体模型可以写为：</span></p>
<p>\begin{equation}<br>	\hat{y} = g_{\phi}(f_{\theta}(x)).<br>\end{equation}</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">这种结构实现了</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBMs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">的两个决定性能力：</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(i) </span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">语义可解释性，因为每个概念维度都与人类可识别的属性对齐；</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(ii) </span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">可干预性，因为用户可以在测试时检查或修改</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">以纠正推理错误。这些特性激发了本综述稍后讨论的一系列架构变体，包括放宽严格瓶颈约束、结合概念间结构化依赖关系或利用多模态基础模型等外部知识的模型。</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1070495/202602/1070495-20260208192053730-1384318721.png" class="lazyload">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; line-height: 150%; text-align: center"><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">图</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">1 CBM</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">流程概览。该图展示了概念是如何被获取、整合至决策制定、进行干预以及评估，从而生成可解释预测的。</span></p>
<h2><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 黑体" lang="EN-US">2.2 </span><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 黑体">分类法</span></h2>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">图</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">1</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">展示了概念瓶颈模型的四部分分类法，而表</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">1</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">总结了这些维度上的代表性方法。我们区分了四个主要维度：</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(1) </span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">概念获取，关注如何构建人类可解释的概念，范围从专家标注到自动发现和语言诱导的词汇表；</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(2) </span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">基于概念的决策，指定概念层如何中介预测，包括严格瓶颈以及松弛或混合设计；</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(3) </span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">概念干预，研究人类或外部系统如何在推理时与概念交互以纠正或指导推理；</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(4) </span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">概念评估，评估以可解释性为导向的属性，如忠实度、稀疏性和干预下的鲁棒性。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">重要的是，越来越多的工作跨越了这些维度，例如在一个架构中联合集成概念获取、决策和干预。因此，我们依次回顾每个维度并强调代表性方法。</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1070495/202602/1070495-20260208192132128-733161976.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p style="text-align: center"><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">表</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">1 </span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">涵盖概念获取、决策、干预和评估的</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBM</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">方法的统一分类体系。概念来源：人工标注</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(manual)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">、词典</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(dict.)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">、视觉原型</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(proto.)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">、大型语言模型</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(LLM)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">；概念空间粒度</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(Gran.)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">：概念与视觉证据对齐的空间层级：全局</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(global)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">、局部</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(local)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">或两者；概念监督</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(Sup.)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">：强</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(strong)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">、弱</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(weak)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">、无监督</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(unsup.)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">；概念瓶颈层</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(Bottleneck)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">：</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">硬</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(hard)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">、软</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(soft)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">、混合</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(hybrid)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">；概念相关性建模</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(corr.)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">：独立</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(indep.)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">、联合</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(joint)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">、图</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(graph)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">、层级</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(hier.)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">、因果</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(causal)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">；干预机制：数值调整</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(scalar)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">、参数化</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(param.)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">、掩码</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">/</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">注意力编辑</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(spatial)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">、自然语言对话</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(lang.)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">；干预策略：随机</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">/</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">人工选择</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(vanilla)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">、模型驱动建议</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(active)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">、修正传播</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(prop.)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">；代码：</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">Link</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">（链接）、</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">– (</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">未发布</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 150%; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">。</span></p>
<h1><span style="font-size: 15pt; font-family: 黑体" lang="EN-US">3 </span><span style="font-size: 15pt; font-family: 黑体">概念获取</span></h1>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">概念构建是概念瓶颈模型的基础，定义了输入和预测之间的人类可解释接口。概念构建已经从完全的人工标注演变为基于词典的挖掘、</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">LLM/VLM</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">引导的生成和视觉原型发现。总体趋势是在提高概念质量、可扩展性和视觉接地的同时减少人工监督。本节回顾四种代表性范式及其核心机制。</span></p>
<h2><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 黑体" lang="EN-US">3.1 </span><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 黑体">基于人工标注的概念</span></h2>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">人工标注通过依赖专家定义和显式标记的概念（如视觉属性或临床发现）提供了最强的语义接地。这种范式确保了高可解释性以及与领域知识的清晰对齐，但从根本上受到标注成本、不完全的概念覆盖和标签噪声的限制。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">该范式最近的工作侧重于在不完美监督下提高鲁棒性和灵活性。一个研究方向是通过修改训练目标来解决噪声或缺失标注的问题，例如</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CPO<sup>[17]</sup></span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">，它引入基于偏好的优化来联合稳定概念预测和下游性能。一个互补的方向是对标注概念间的依赖关系进行建模，以减轻泄漏和表达能力的限制。</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">Havasi</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">等人</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[18]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">用潜在侧信道变量增强了人工标注的概念，并采用自回归预测器来捕捉概念间的结构。为了支持实际部署，</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">Editable CBMs<sup>[19]</sup></span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">支持使用基于影响函数的更新对概念定义和数据集标签进行事后修正，而无需完全重新训练。尽管有这些进展，人工标注仍然难以扩展到复杂领域，且其对预定义概念集的依赖限制了对不断变化任务的适应性。</span></p>
<h2><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 黑体" lang="EN-US">3.2 </span><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 黑体">基于词典的概念构建</span></h2>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">基于词典的方法用从预定义词汇表（如形容词列表或医学描述符）中的可扩展发现取代了特定任务的人工定义。通过将概念空间限制为语言上有意义的单元，与全自动生成相比，这些方法提供了更好的可控性和透明度。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">代表性方法侧重于从大型词库中过滤出视觉接地的概念。</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">V2C-CBM<sup>[20]</sup></span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">构建了一个</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">n-gram</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">候选池，并使用基于</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CLIP</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">的视觉</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">-</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">语言相似度来移除与视觉无关或接地较弱的条目，产生紧凑且可解释的概念集。</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">OpenCBM<sup>[9]</sup></span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">进一步将可训练的视觉特征与</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CLIP</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">嵌入对齐，并引入了发现缺失概念的机制，从而提高了超出初始词典的覆盖范围。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">虽然基于词典的构建降低了标注成本并限制了幻觉风险，但其表达能力仍然受到预定义词汇表的限制，可能无法捕捉细粒度或特定任务的语义。</span></p>
<h2><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 黑体" lang="EN-US">3.3 </span><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;" lang="EN-US">LLM/VLM</span><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 黑体">引导的概念生成</span></h2>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">LLM</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">和</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">VLM</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">引导的概念生成通过利用大型语言模型产生多样化、高层次且通常是分层的语义，大幅扩展了概念空间。这种范式提供了强大的可扩展性和灵活性，但也引入了与幻觉、弱视觉接地和语义不稳定性相关的新挑战。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">最近的工作通过结构、对齐和统计正则化来解决这些问题。</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">Med-MICN<sup>[21]</sup></span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">将概念组织成多层级结构，并采用门控机制来控制抽象程度。视觉</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">-</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">语言一致性约束</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[22, 23, 24]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">和提示级对齐策略</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[25]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">进一步提高了接地的可靠性。从监督角度来看，</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">Label-free CBMs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">和</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">FCBM<sup>[26, 27]</sup></span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">证明，只要施加了强大的视觉正则化，通过将</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">LLM</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">与</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CLIP</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">结合，可以在没有显式标注的情况下诱导出可用概念。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">总体而言，</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">LLM/VLM</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">引导的概念获取显著降低了人类监督要求，但其可解释性最终取决于语言先验的可靠性和接地约束的有效性。</span></p>
<h2><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 黑体" lang="EN-US">3.4 </span><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 黑体">基于视觉原型的概念发现</span></h2>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">基于视觉原型的方法通过提取代表性区域、部件或解缠组件，直接从图像空间学习概念，产生强大的视觉接地和空间定位。这种范式对于医学成像和其他形态学证据对决策至关重要的领域特别有吸引力。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">基于原型的发现面临固有的挑战，包括不稳定的语义命名、显著性驱动的虚假相关性以及原型粒度与覆盖范围之间的权衡。最近的工作探索了几种设计模式来减轻这些限制。面向解缠的方法，如</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">HU-MCD</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">、</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">LCBM<sup>[28, 29]</sup></span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">，学习多维概念因子以减少语义未指明性。面向部署的方法</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[30, 31]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">专注于从预训练模型中提取原型词典以实现事后可解释性。面向交互的设计</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[32, 33]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">显式地将原型与空间区域关联，支持区域级的检查和干预。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">尽管接地保真度有所提高，但在数据集之间实现视觉原型的稳定语义对齐和可扩展重用仍然是一个开放的挑战。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24.1pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><strong><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">总结。</span></strong><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US"> CBMs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">中的概念获取涵盖了从专家定义的语义到自动发现的范围，反映了语义精度、监督成本和鲁棒性之间的权衡，并激发了整合语言和视觉线索的混合设计。</span></p>
<h1><span style="font-size: 15pt; font-family: 黑体" lang="EN-US">4 </span><span style="font-size: 15pt; font-family: 黑体">基于概念的决策</span></h1>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">概念瓶颈模型</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(CBMs)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">通过可解释概念层中介预测来提高可解释性，使验证和干预成为可能。除了概念构建，</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBM</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">架构也在不断演变以增强灵活性和可部署性。本节回顾三个关键方向：瓶颈设计、概念监督和模型适应，强调了从硬性流程向自适应、与人类对齐的决策转变。</span></p>
<h2><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 黑体" lang="EN-US">4.1 </span><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 黑体">瓶颈设计</span></h2>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBMs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">的一项核心创新在于概念瓶颈如何通过中介输入和输出之间的信息流来管理决策过程。早期的设计强制执行严格的流程，即所有预测信号必须通过离散的、可解释的概念层，从而最大化透明度和可干预性。然而，这种刚性结构往往限制了表示能力，并在不完美的概念监督下损害性能。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">为了解决这些限制，引入了软瓶颈</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[33, 34]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">，实现了连续的概念激活以及概念和任务预测器的联合优化。随后的变体通过残差通路</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[49]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">和结构化依赖关系放宽了严格瓶颈，包括自回归序列</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[15]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">、图先验</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[61, 52]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">和随机潜变量</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[57]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">。</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">Energy-based CBMs<sup>[60]</sup></span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">进一步在联合概率框架内统一了预测和干预。更近期的工作将更高层次的结构注入瓶颈，例如用于鲁棒干预的因果图</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[6]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">，用于减轻概念</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">-</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">标签失真的概念解耦</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[64]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">，以及用于在复杂设置中超越线性聚合的可微逻辑组合</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[58, 13]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">这些进展共同反映了严格瓶颈向更具表达力和结构化架构的逐渐放松，使</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBMs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">能够在复杂的现实环境中更好地平衡可解释性和预测能力，同时保留概念层作为解释和干预的对齐语义接口。</span></p>
<h2><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 黑体" lang="EN-US">4.2 </span><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 黑体">概念监督</span></h2>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">概念监督定义了</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBMs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">的中间语义层是如何构建和接地的。虽然早期模型依赖于具有强领域语义的人工标注概念</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[5]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">，但这种监督通常成本高昂、稀疏或特定于领域。因此，最近的研究寻求可扩展到更广泛任务且同时保留语义可解释性的替代方案。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">Post-hoc CBMs<sup>[44]</sup></span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">通过在冻结的编码器之上学习概念预测器来绕过架构约束，无需重新训练即可恢复概念可解释性。基于探测的方法</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[45]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">和原型发现方法</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[32, 30]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">使用稀疏正则化或基于部件的分解从预训练特征中提取可解释单元。利用视觉</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">-</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">语言模型，基于</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CLIP</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">的流程</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[46, 26, 47]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">将概念标签与文本提示对齐，实现开放词汇监督。</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">LLM</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">引导的策略</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[21, 22, 48, 49]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">更进一步，通过生成分层或特定任务的概念，尽管视觉接地和幻觉方面的挑战仍然存在。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">这些方法将概念监督从直接标注转变为基于对齐和提示的归纳，实现了可扩展和自适应的概念构建。这种演变保留了</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBMs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">与人类对齐的语义，同时提高了跨任务和领域的灵活性。</span></p>
<h2><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 黑体" lang="EN-US">4.3 </span><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 黑体">模型适应</span></h2>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">为了使</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBMs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">在现实世界和不断变化的环境中具有实用价值，它们必须支持动态适应。具有固定概念的静态流程在任务需求转变、新概念出现或需要用户修正时难以更新。因此，模型适应已成为可操作</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBMs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">的一个关键前沿。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">Editable CBMs<sup>[19]</sup></span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">引入了基于影响函数的参数更新，允许对概念、实例或标签预测进行局部更改，而无需完全重新训练。这允许在保留模型整体结构的同时进行细粒度的修正和数据集更新。概率能量模型</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[13]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">通过将推理公式化为输入、概念和输出上的能量最小化来支持测试时修正。更具交互性的是，最近的方法如</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">Chat-CBM<sup>[50]</sup></span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">和</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">SALF<sup>[51]</sup></span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">扩展了模型接口以支持自然语言和基于空间区域的干预，使非技术用户也能进行适应。无需训练的测试时适应</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[52, 53]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">进一步使</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBMs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">能够仅使用少量图像级标签处理概念级分布偏移，而无需重新训练或概念监督。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">这些进展标志着从静态可解释性向动态、人在回路决策的转变。适应性</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBMs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">保留了其核心语义瓶颈，同时允许部署后编辑、修正和协作，扩展了其在现实世界高风险系统中的生存能力。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24.1pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><strong><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">总结。</span></strong><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US"> CBMs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">中的基于概念的决策已从严格的瓶颈管道演变为更灵活的架构，更好地平衡了可解释性和性能。瓶颈设计、监督和模型适应方面的进步将概念层定位为用于预测和干预的动态接口。</span></p>
<h1><span style="font-size: 15pt; font-family: 黑体" lang="EN-US">5 </span><span style="font-size: 15pt; font-family: 黑体">概念干预</span></h1>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">概念干预通过修正中间概念实现人类与</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">AI</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">的协作，将</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBMs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">从被动的可解释模型转变为交互式系统。在</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">Koh</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">等人</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[5]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">的开创性工作中，干预被公式化为允许用户修改概念激活值的测试时编辑。虽然具有基础意义，但这种范式依赖于强独立性假设，产生高昂的人力成本，并支持有限的交互模式。</span></p>
<h2><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 黑体" lang="EN-US">5.1 </span><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 黑体">概念相关性</span></h2>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">早期的干预机制通常假设概念是独立的，这意味着修改一个概念不会影响其他概念。这种假设在现实世界设置中通常是不现实的，因为概念在复杂决策任务中实际上表现出很强的语义和统计依赖性。为了解决这一限制，相关性感知的干预方法显式地对概念间关系进行建模并据此传播修正。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">Havasi</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">等人</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[18]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">提出了自回归概念预测器，允许对前概念的干预通过序列依赖建模影响后续预测。</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">Stochastic CBMs<sup>[39]</sup></span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">通过将概念</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">Logits</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">建模为多元正态分布，进一步提高了效率，实现了通过学习到的协方差结构即时传播单个干预。</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">Energy-Based CBMs<sup>[13]</sup></span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">采用输入、概念和输出上的联合能量公式，允许概念修正通过能量最小化进行传播。</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">Singhi</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">等人</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[38]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">引入了事后概念重对齐模块</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(CIRM)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">，根据学习到的统计相关性更新未干预的概念。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">虽然这些方法显著提高了干预的一致性和效率，但它们关键地依赖于学习到的相关性的质量。如果捕捉到虚假依赖关系，干预可能会传播错误而不是修正，这突显了一个重要的开放挑战。</span></p>
<h2><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 黑体" lang="EN-US">5.2 </span><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 黑体">概念定位</span></h2>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">确定干预哪些概念仍然是实际部署中的主要瓶颈，因为人工选择是劳动密集的且对认知具有高要求的。为了减轻这一负担，最近的工作已转向模型引导的定位策略，优先考虑高影响力的干预目标。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">一些方法将定位内化到训练或模型设计中。</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">Espinosa Zarlenga</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">等人</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[10]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">引入了感知干预的训练，在学习过程中模拟测试时干预，使模型能够推荐需要修正的概念。</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">Evidential CEM(evi-CEM)<sup>[54]</sup></span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">将概念预测建模为</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">Beta</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">分布，利用认知不确定性指导对模糊概念的干预。其他方法依赖于事后分析或辅助结构。</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">Shin</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">等人</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[14]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">提出了基于不确定性的概念潜力</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(UCP)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">和概念预测损失</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(LCP)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">等指标来对干预优先级进行排序。</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">Shen</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">等人</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[55]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">进一步引入了</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">FIGS-BD</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">，将预测器蒸馏为贪婪求和树，以识别具有高贡献方差的概念组。</span></p>
<h2><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 黑体" lang="EN-US">5.3 </span><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 黑体">概念交互</span></h2>
