<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">除了选择和修正概念值之外，最近的工作越来越多地探索更丰富的交互模式，这些模式对人类用户来说更直观</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[56]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">。</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">Chat-CBM<sup>[50]</sup></span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">用大语言模型替换基于概念的预测器，允许用户通过自然语言对话进行干预。虽然这在实践中提高了可用性，但可能会削弱传统</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBMs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">的严格可解释性保证。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">在视觉领域，</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">Concept-based Similarity Reasoning (CSR)<sup>[33]</sup></span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">通过允许用户绘制边界框来引导模型注意力，实现了空间交互。然而，这种空间引导并没有显式地解耦不同概念间的干预。</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">Spatially-Aware and Label-Free (SALF) CBM<sup>[51]</sup></span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">通过利用空间概念图解决了这一限制，使用户能够指定感兴趣的区域并选择性地调节该区域内单个概念的激活。除了判别模型，概念瓶颈生成模型将概念级交互扩展到</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">GANs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">、</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">VAEs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">和扩散模型，实现了生成的可解释引导和调试</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[57]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24.1pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><strong><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">总结。</span></strong><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">概念干预将</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBMs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">从静态解释模型转变为交互式的人在回路系统。通过建模概念相关性、实现干预目标的有效定位以及支持更丰富的交互模式，最近的进展提高了概念级修正的有效性和可用性。</span></p>
<h1><span style="font-size: 15pt; font-family: 黑体" lang="EN-US">6 </span><span style="font-size: 15pt; font-family: 黑体">概念瓶颈模型的评估</span></h1>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">概念瓶颈模型引入了可解释和可干预的中间概念，这要求评估协议超越下游任务性能。因此，现有的评估框架评估三个核心维度：概念忠实度、概念稀疏性和可干预性，从而捕捉语义有效性、认知易处理性和人在回路的可控性。</span></p>
<h2><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 黑体" lang="EN-US">6.1 </span><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 黑体">概念忠实度</span></h2>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">概念忠实度衡量学习到的瓶颈表示是否与人类可理解的语义对齐，这是实践中可靠解释和有效干预的前提。评估策略已从直接标签匹配演变为对内在结构和外部接地的更严格评估。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24.1pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><strong><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">标签对齐。</span></strong><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">一种常见的方法是使用标准指标（如准确率和</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">F1</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">分数）评估预测概念与真实标注之间的一致性。然而，在高维和稀疏概念空间中，这些指标可能由真负样本主导。为了减轻这种偏差，最近的工作强调使用</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">Jaccard</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">相似度</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[58]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">和概念存在度量</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(CEM)<sup>[59]</sup></span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">等指标进行主动概念评估，这些指标侧重于被正向激活的概念。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24.1pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><strong><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">内在表示质量。</span></strong><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">除了标签匹配外，有效的概念表示应具有连贯的拓扑结构和明显的可分离性。在基于嵌入的模型中，概念对齐分数</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(CAS)<sup>[10]</sup></span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">解决了的前者的评估，验证高维空间中的局部邻域是否保持语义同质性。作为补充，为了在基于标量的瓶颈中解决的后者的评估，</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">Gap<sup>[60, 61]</sup></span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">通过测量正负激活分布之间的散度来评估潜在空间的可分性，从而量化表示的内在判别质量。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24.1pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><strong><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">语义和视觉接地。</span></strong><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">为了检测虚假相关性，进一步的评估将学习到的概念与外部语义或视觉参考对齐。语义接地指标，包括</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CGIM<sup>[59]</sup></span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">、</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">Similarity<sup> [36]</sup></span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">和概念纯度</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[11]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">，评估与人类定义的重要性或与规范嵌入的一致性。视觉接地指标，如概念可信度分数</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[32]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">和</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CLM<sup>[59]</sup></span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">，量化概念激活与标注区域之间的空间对齐。虽然在实践中有效，但这些方法通常需要昂贵的标注；基于</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">VLM</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">的替代方案如概念</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">-</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">图像相关性</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[11]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">减少了监督，但引入了潜在的幻觉风险。</span></p>
<h2><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 黑体" lang="EN-US">6.2 </span><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 黑体">概念稀疏性</span></h2>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">概念稀疏性评估</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBMs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">是否依赖于一组最小且认知上可管理的概念。过度密集的瓶颈破坏了可解释性并增加了信息泄漏的风险。稀疏度</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[58]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">和有效概念数</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(NEC)<sup>[62]</sup></span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">等指标量化了激活密度和推理复杂性。然而，稀疏性必须与任务性能联合考虑。为了捕捉这种权衡，概念利用效率</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(CUE)<sup>[36]</sup></span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">和概念高效准确率</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(CEA)<sup>[63]</sup></span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">等复合指标在预测准确率与概念使用之间进行平衡，其中</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CEA</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">提供了一个有界的、文本不变的公式以进行稳健比较。</span></p>
<h2><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 黑体" lang="EN-US">6.3 </span><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 黑体">可干预性</span></h2>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">可干预性反映了</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBMs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">在推理时支持有效人类修正的能力。此类别的评估协议评估模型预测对概念级修正的响应能力以及干预策略的效率。测试时干预</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(TTI)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">曲线</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[5]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">及其曲线下面积变体</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[64]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">被广泛用于总结在增加干预预算下的性能增益。扩展这一分析，最近的工作检查了相关概念间的修正传播</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[39]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">，并通过经验用户时间</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[60]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">或理论复杂性</span><sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">[14, 65]</span></sup><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">显式地建模干预成本。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24.1pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><strong><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">总结。</span></strong><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">评估</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBMs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">需要超越下游准确率的整体协议。概念忠实度确保语义有效性，概念稀疏性保持认知易处理性，可干预性量化人在回路修正的有效性和成本。这些维度共同构成了评估</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBMs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">可解释性、可靠性和实用性的原则基础。</span></p>
<h1><span style="font-size: 15pt; font-family: 黑体" lang="EN-US">7 </span><span style="font-size: 15pt; font-family: 黑体">基准</span></h1>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">表</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">2</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">总结了用于评估一般和医疗领域概念瓶颈模型</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(CBMs)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">的代表性基准。这些数据集在概念标注来源、监督粒度和对概念级干预的支持方面存在显著差异，这反过来决定了</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBMs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">的哪些方面（如忠实度、可扩展性或可干预性）可以得到可靠评估。与深度模型不同，</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBMs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">依赖于基准设计来验证概念忠实度和干预有效性。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24.1pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><strong><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">一般领域数据集。</span></strong><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">一般领域基准在视觉和文本识别任务上评估</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBMs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">，包括细粒度分类、零样本学习和</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">NLP</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">应用。一个关键区别在于概念监督。具有人工标注概念的数据集，如</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CUB-200-2011</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">和</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">AWA2</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">，支持概念评估和测试时干预，使概念修正的因果分析成为可能。相比之下，依赖</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">LLM</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">或</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">VLM</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">生成概念的大规模基准评估可扩展性和开放词汇能力，但缺乏经过验证的真实值，因此无法支持基于干预的评估。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24.1pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><strong><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">医疗领域数据集。</span></strong><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">医疗基准强调临床上有意义的概念和安全关键的可解释性，使其特别适合评估概念忠实度和干预有效性。具有专家标注、有序或连续概念的数据集显式支持干预实验，并能够验证现实临床设置中人在回路的修正。依赖自动生成概念的大型医疗数据集提高了覆盖范围和可扩展性，但缺乏经过验证的概念标注通常限制了它们进行严格干预和因果分析的适用性。</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1070495/202602/1070495-20260208192204239-306484748.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p style="text-align: center">&nbsp;<span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">表</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">2 </span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">通用和医疗领域中评估概念瓶颈模型</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(CBMs)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">的代表性基准</span></p>
<h1><span style="font-size: 15pt; font-family: 黑体" lang="EN-US">8 </span><span style="font-size: 15pt; font-family: 黑体">总结与未来方向</span></h1>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">概念瓶颈模型通过将预测建立在人类可理解的概念之上，为可解释和可控的决策提供了一个原则性框架。本综述统一了涵盖概念获取、决策、干预和评估全流程的</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBM</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">研究，特别强调了高风险医疗应用。尽管取得了实质性进展，但仍存在若干基本挑战。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 24pt; mso-char-indent-count: 2.0; line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBMs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">的未来研究方向包括：</span><strong><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">(1) </span></strong><strong><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">自适应概念获取。</span></strong><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">未来的</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">CBMs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">应超越固定的瓶颈设计，转向自适应和结构化的概念表示，如分层、组合或稀疏激活的瓶颈。这种设计更好地反映了人类语义的多层次和任务依赖性质，同时提高了效率。</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体"> <strong><span lang="EN-US">(2) </span></strong></span><strong><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">忠实可靠的概念。</span></strong><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">确保学习到的概念忠实地对应其预期语义仍然是一个核心挑战，特别是在弱监督下或概念源自</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">LLMs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">或</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">VLMs</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">时。有前景的方向包括不确定性感知建模、减轻虚假相关性的因果表示学习，以及检测或纠正不稳定概念的机制。</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体"> <strong><span lang="EN-US">(3) </span></strong></span><strong><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">结构化概念干预。</span></strong><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">除了直接的概念替换，未来的工作应探索结构化干预策略，考虑概念间的依赖关系并识别决策关键子集。支持部分或软干预对于减少工作量并在安全关键领域实现可扩展的专家在环部署至关重要。</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体"> <strong><span lang="EN-US">(4) </span></strong></span><strong><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">鲁棒的概念评估。</span></strong><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: 宋体; mso-ascii-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-hansi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Times New Roman'">鲁棒评估对于可靠部署仍然是必要的。未来的研究应审查概念表示和干预效果如何在跨领域和偏移中泛化，以及基于概念的推理如何支持不确定性估计、分布外检测和感知干预的评估协议。</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 20pt; mso-line-height-rule: exactly"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, &quot;serif&quot;; mso-fareast-font-family: 宋体" lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p>
